# API map

Every call on the backend's `app` next to its page twin on `tiny`, one row per operation. A page's `tiny.app.X` is the backend's `app.X`, and `tiny.win.X` (the page's own window) pairs with `app.win.X` (the main window); `app.window(id)` handles have the same window methods as `app.win` minus `open`, `windows` and `setHideOnClose`, and their `close()` takes no id.

Generated from `tiny.d.ts`, checked against the live `app` and `tiny` objects and line by line against the code — 136 same · 36 page only · 12 backend only · 3 args differ · 2 returns differ.

[bridge](#bridge) · [windows](#win) · [menus](#menu) · [tray](#tray) · [hotkeys](#hotkey) · [dialogs](#dialog) · [notifications](#notify) · [app](#app) · [system](#system) · [theme](#theme) · [clipboard](#clipboard) · [store](#store) · [audio](#audio) · [macos only](#macos) · [events](#events) · [deprecated](#deprecated)

<label class="api-map-filter"><input type="checkbox" id="hide-same"> hide rows that match</label>
<span class="api-map-hint">"returns differ" mostly means the page resolves <code>true</code> where the backend returns nothing</span>

<tr class="st-ret"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.audio.sampler.play</b>(name: string, opts?: { vol?: number; pan?: number; rate?: number; loop?: boolean; }) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;{ id: number; set(patch: { vol?: number; pan?: number; rate?: number; }): true; stop(): true; }&gt;</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.audio.sampler.play</b>(name: string, opts?: { vol?: number; pan?: number; rate?: number; loop?: boolean; }) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinySamplerVoice&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-ret">returns differ</span><div class="doc">Fire a voice.</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-back"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.audio.sampler.stop</b>(id: number) <span class="ret">→ true</span></code></td><td class="none">—</td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-back">backend only</span><div class="doc">stop a voice by id (same as voice.stop())</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.audio.sampler.stopAll</b>() <span class="ret">→ true</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.audio.sampler.stopAll</b>() <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;void&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-same">same</span></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.audio.sampler.unload</b>(name: string) <span class="ret">→ true</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.audio.sampler.unload</b>(name: string) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;void&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-same">same</span><div class="doc">Drop a sound and free its decoded PCM.</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-page"><td class="none">—</td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.audioTap.on</b>(fn: (chunk: { pcm: string; sampleRate: number; channels: number; frames: number; t: number; }) =&gt; void) <span class="ret">→ () =&gt; void</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-page">page only</span><div class="doc">Register a chunk handler.</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-page"><td class="none">—</td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.audioTap.start</b>(opts?: { scope?: "app" | "system"; excludeSelf?: boolean; interval?: number; }) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;true&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-page">page only</span><div class="doc">Start tapping.</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-page"><td class="none">—</td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.audioTap.stop</b>() <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;void&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-page">page only</span></td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>

## macOS only {#macos}

<div class="api-map-table" v-pre><table><thead><tr><th>backend <code>app</code></th><th>page <code>tiny</code></th><th>notes</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.macos.ai.availability</b>() <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinyAiAvailability&gt;</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.macos.ai.availability</b>() <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinyAiAvailability&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-same">same</span></td></tr>
<tr class="st-diff"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.macos.ai.generate</b>(prompt: string, opts?: { instructions?: string; }) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;string&gt;</span></code><code class="sig"><b>app.macos.ai.generate</b>(prompt: string, opts: { instructions?: string; tools: TinyAiTool[]; }) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;{ text: string; calls: TinyAiCall[]; }&gt;</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.macos.ai.generate</b>(prompt: string, opts?: { instructions?: string; }) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;string&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-diff">args differ</span><div class="doc">offline, no API key.</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.macos.applescript</b>(source: string) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;string | null&gt;</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.macos.applescript</b>(source: string) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;string | null&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-same">same</span><div class="doc">run AppleScript in-process (no osascript spawn; 'automation' TCC); resolves the result as a string, null if it isn't text; rejects with the script error message</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.macos.moveWindow</b>(pid: number, rect: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; }) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;true&gt;</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.macos.moveWindow</b>(pid: number, rect: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; }) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;true&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-same">same</span><div class="doc">move/resize another app's frontmost window (pid from otherWindows)</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.macos.ocr</b>(path: string) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinyOcrResult&gt;</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.macos.ocr</b>(path: string) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinyOcrResult&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-same">same</span><div class="doc">on-device OCR via Vision (accurate mode); box normalized 0..1</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.macos.otherWindows</b>() <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinyOtherWindow[] | null&gt;</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.macos.otherWindows</b>() <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinyOtherWindow[] | null&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-same">same</span><div class="doc">other apps' on-screen windows (Accessibility); null if not granted</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.macos.quickLook</b>(paths?: string | string[] | null) <span class="ret">→ boolean</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.macos.quickLook</b>(paths?: string | string[] | null) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;void&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-same">same</span><div class="doc">Quick Look panel for the path(s); no args closes it</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.macos.recorder.start</b>(opts: { path: string; screenId?: number; }) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;true&gt;</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.macos.recorder.start</b>(opts: { path: string; screenId?: number; }) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;true&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-same">same</span><div class="doc">resolves once capture is running; needs the 'screen' permission + macOS 14, rejects with the reason otherwise</div></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.macos.recorder.stop</b>() <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinyRecording&gt;</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.macos.recorder.stop</b>() <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinyRecording&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-same">same</span></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.macos.selectedText</b>() <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;string | null&gt;</span></code></td><td><code class="sig"><b>tiny.macos.selectedText</b>() <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;string | null&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note"><span class="badge b-same">same</span><div class="doc">text selected in the frontmost app (Accessibility); null if none</div></td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>

## Events {#events}

The backend hooks are exports of your backend module, wired once at startup; the page subscribes at runtime and gets back an unsubscribe function.

<div class="api-map-table" v-pre><table><thead><tr><th>backend <code>app</code></th><th>page <code>tiny</code></th><th>notes</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onMenu</b>(id, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.menu.on(fn)</code></td><td class="note">menu bar click</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onContextMenu</b>(id, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.menu.onContext(fn)</code></td><td class="note">custom right-click menu click</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onTray</b>(id | null, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.tray.on(fn) / tiny.tray.onClick(fn)</code></td><td class="note">tray menu item / bare icon click (one hook on the backend, two on the page)</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onHotkey</b>(id, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.hotkey.on(fn)</code></td><td class="note">global hotkey pressed</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onSystem</b>(kind, value, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.theme.on(fn(dark))</code></td><td class="note">theme / sleep / wake — the page has sugar for theme only; sleep/wake via tiny.api.on</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onLocale</b>(info, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.api.on('locale', fn)</code></td><td class="note">no page sugar; macOS only for now (no locale reader on Windows/Linux)</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onOpenUrl</b>(url, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.app.onOpenUrl(fn)</code></td><td class="note"></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onOpenFiles</b>(paths, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.app.onOpenFiles(fn)</code></td><td class="note"></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onNotificationClick</b>(id, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.app.onNotificationClick(fn)</code></td><td class="note"></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onNotificationAction</b>(info, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.app.onNotificationAction(fn)</code></td><td class="note"></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onMediaKey</b>(info, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.app.onMediaKey(fn)</code></td><td class="note"></td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onWindowState</b>(info, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.win.onState(fn)</code></td><td class="note">broadcast to every window</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onWindowClosed</b>(id, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.api.on('window-closed', fn)</code></td><td class="note">no page sugar; the page gets { id }, the hook a bare id</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onClipboardChange</b>(info, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.clipboard.onChange(fn)</code></td><td class="note">both start a watch</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onAudioTap</b>(chunk, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.audioTap.on(fn)</code></td><td class="note">only a page can start the tap</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onUpdateAvailable</b>(info, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.api.on('update-available', fn)</code></td><td class="note">no page sugar</td></tr>
<tr class="st-page"><td><span class="none">—</span></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.win.onDrop(fn)</code></td><td class="note">page only; the launcher's drop carries no window id, so every window hears it</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onNavigate</b>(info, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.api.on('navigate', fn)</code></td><td class="note">pages hear the lifecycle (start/commit/finish/fail/crash); only the backend answers the policy ask</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onDownload</b>(info, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.api.on('download', fn)</code></td><td class="note">pages hear progress; only the backend answers the policy ask</td></tr>
<tr class="st-same"><td><code class="sig">export function <b>onWindowOpen</b>(info, app)</code></td><td><code class="sig">tiny.api.on('popup', fn)</code></td><td class="note">backend decides; the page hears 'popup' (no kind field)</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>

## Deprecated backend names {#deprecated}

Still work, log a one-line warning the first time each is used, and will be removed in a future release.

<div class="api-map-table" v-pre><table><thead><tr><th>old backend name</th><th>use instead</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.getMenuItem</b>(id: string) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinyMenuItemState&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note">use app.menu.get()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.getWinState</b>() <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinyWinState | null&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note">use app.win.getState()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.openWindow</b>(id: string, opts?: TinyOpenWindowOptions) <span class="ret">→ void</span></code></td><td class="note">use app.win.open()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.setAudioBalance</b>(v: number) <span class="ret">→ void</span></code></td><td class="note">use app.audio.balance()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.setAudioFilter</b>(index: number, patch: Partial&lt;TinyAudioFilter&gt;) <span class="ret">→ void</span></code></td><td class="note">use app.audio.filter()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.setAudioFilters</b>(list: TinyAudioFilter[]) <span class="ret">→ void</span></code></td><td class="note">use app.audio.filters()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.setContextMenu</b>(items: TinyMenuItem[] | null) <span class="ret">→ void</span></code></td><td class="note">use app.menu.setContext()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.setMenu</b>(menus: TinyMenu[]) <span class="ret">→ void</span></code></td><td class="note">use app.menu.set()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.updateMenuItem</b>(id: string, patch?: { label?: string; checked?: boolean; enabled?: boolean; }) <span class="ret">→ void</span></code></td><td class="note">use app.menu.update()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.win.getMenuItem</b>(id: string) <span class="ret">→ Promise&lt;TinyMenuItemState&gt;</span></code></td><td class="note">use menu.get()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.win.resetMenu</b>() <span class="ret">→ void</span></code></td><td class="note">use menu.reset()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.win.setMenu</b>(menus: TinyMenu[]) <span class="ret">→ void</span></code></td><td class="note">use menu.set()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.win.updateMenuItem</b>(id: string, patch?: { label?: string; checked?: boolean; enabled?: boolean; }) <span class="ret">→ void</span></code></td><td class="note">use menu.update()</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.notify</b>({ title, body, …opts })</code></td><td class="note">app.notify(title, body, opts)</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.info.version</b>, <b>app.paths.data</b>, …</code></td><td class="note">(await app.info()).version, (await app.paths()).data</td></tr>
<tr class="st-dep"><td><code class="sig"><b>app.presence</b>(anything but 'normal' | 'menubar')</code></td><td class="note">will throw, as the page call does</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
